title: Apple Uncertain About Future Foldable iPhone Availability
excerpt: Apple's new foldable iPhone Duo quickly sold out, though the company is currently unsure when more units will become available.
body_html:
Apple has stated that it is currently unsure when additional foldable iPhones will be available for purchase after the initial stock sold out completely.

The newly released foldable device, known as the iPhone Duo, proved to be a popular choice among consumers despite carrying a price tag of $2,000.

Apple has not yet provided a specific timeline for when restocking might occur or when more units will hit the market.
